context.body: Preexistent glory, mission, distinction, mutual indwelling, and human unity are carefully related.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Jesus addresses the Father, speaks of shared glory before the world, gives eternal life through knowing Father and Son, and asks for protected, sanctified unity.
observations.label: Jesus prays to the Father about glory and unity: action

observations.body: Disciples are given words and sent; future believers are included in the prayer.
observations.label: Jesus prays to the Father about glory and unity: response

observations.body: glorify your Son · before the world existed · know you · may they be one
observations.label: Words in John 17:1–26

payload.posture: Read John 17:1–26 as jesus and god evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The prayer compares believer unity with Father-Son unity without making the two relations identical in every respect.
payload.title: Jesus prays to the Father about glory and unity
